summary: Tested Super Admin User Permissions Management feature. Backend: All 16 API tests passed for GET /api/admin/permissions and PUT /api/admin/users/{user_id}/permissions. Frontend: Successfully tested permission edit flow - Companies tab, View Users (Eye icon), Edit Permissions (Shield icon), Select All/Deselect All buttons, individual permission checkboxes, and Save Permissions functionality.

issues: The Shield icon appears to be rendering correctly as a loading spinner initially, but functions correctly when clicked. May want to verify icon loading state.

GET /api/admin/permissions.details: Returns all 10 permissions with id, name_en, name_ar fields. Permissions: dashboard, hr, financial, invoices, purchases, projects, analytics, settings, users, approvals

PUT /api/admin/users/{user_id}/permissio.details: Successfully updates user permissions. Returns user_id, permissions array, and success message. Invalid permissions rejected with 400, non-existent users return 404, unauthenticated requests return 401

GET /api/admin/companies/{company_id}/us.details: Returns users with permissions field included

companies_tab.details: Companies tab shows table with Company, Email, Users, Plan, Status, End Date, Actions columns

view_users_eye_icon.details: Eye icon in Companies table opens Company Users section showing Name, Email, Role, Status, Actions columns

edit_permissions_shield_icon.details: Shield icon in user Actions column opens Edit Permissions modal

permissions_modal_content.details: Modal shows user info (name, email, role), Select All/Deselect All buttons, 10 permission checkboxes, Selected count, Cancel and Save Permissions buttons

select_all_button.details: Select All button selects all 10 permissions

deselect_all_button.details: Deselect All button clears all permissions

toggle_permissions.details: Individual permission checkboxes can be toggled on/off

save_permissions_button.details: Save Permissions button submits changes to backend

context_for_next_testing_agent: Super Admin User Permissions Management feature fully tested and working.
